# links (Manuel Szedlak)

> Manuel Szedlak is a founder and engineer: distributed systems, AI/ML training and inference, service architecture. This site collects his links and lets you book a meeting.

The page exists in 10 languages: https://m4nuel.com/en (also de, es, fr, zh-CN, ja, pt-BR, ru, hi, ar).

## Links

- [m4nuel.blog](https://m4nuel.blog): notes on software, written and served in Rust; full text at https://m4nuel.blog/llms-full.txt
- [m4nuel.net](https://m4nuel.net): profile and opinions in 12 languages
- [GitHub](https://github.com/m4nyu)
- [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/manuel-szedlak)
- [X](https://x.com/ManuelSzedlak)

## Contact

A 30-minute meeting can be booked from the "Schedule a meeting" button on https://m4nuel.com/en.
